request: Can you stack my dryer on my washer to free up floor space?
contractor_reply: Manufacturer does not approve these two as a stack. Owner wants an estimate for measuring side-by-side alcove only, no price supplied.

request: The new dryer is here. Can you move the dryer cord from the old machine?
contractor_reply: Installer confirmed manufacturer-approved new cord matches receptacle; do not reuse old cord. [amount withheld] includes new cord, connection, vent reconnect and test.

request: Our ventless dryer is arriving. What do you need for the install?
contractor_reply: Model uses its tank, outlet and clearances verified. [amount withheld] set, level, run test and show tank emptying. No duct or drain hookup.

request: Can we move our washer from the basement to the upstairs closet?
contractor_reply: Owner's plumber/electrician prepare and test services. My [amount withheld] covers moving and reconnecting washer once ready; access checked. Dryer stays.

request: We want a new disposal where the old one leaks.
contractor_reply: Like-for-like plug-in unit and flange, owner supplies disposal. [amount withheld] covers swap, reconnect and leak/function test; leave old unit with owner.

request: Can you install a built-in ice maker in this empty wet bar opening?
contractor_reply: Model requires drain; no drain confirmed. Owner orders a plumber feasibility visit. My future install is unpriced and not authorized.

request: Can you put our freestanding wine cooler behind a cabinet door?
contractor_reply: Manual requires freestanding ventilation. Owner approved open freestanding location with verified outlet. [amount withheld] to place, level and test only.

request: Can you freshen up our bathroom without tearing into the shower?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] fixed labor to replace owner-supplied mirror, vanity in same spot and light, plus paint walls. Electrician hired and paid directly by owner for the light; my [amount withheld] excludes that electrical work. Keep shower/floor.

request: We want the bathroom gutted and put back, including a tiled shower.
contractor_reply: I do demolition and tile only, [amount withheld] lump sum for these two. GC supplies signed-off waterproofed substrate; plumber and glass by others, owner buys tile. Haul included.

request: Our cabinet boxes are good. Can you replace the doors and countertops?
contractor_reply: 18 new door fronts and hardware installed by me for [amount withheld]. Fabricator bills owner separately for tops. Existing boxes and appliances stay; I do not measure or install tops.

request: Can you knock our kitchen back to studs and give us a new layout?
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] for my selective demo and haul after utilities disconnected by owner's trades. Layout/design and rebuild by GC, no wall removal until GC identifies it. Only approved nonstructural cabinets and finishes this phase.

request: Can you make two basement rooms into one family room?
contractor_reply: Nonbearing status not established. I'm quoting [amount withheld] exploratory site review, no demolition. Owner's engineer assesses wall separately.

request: We want a place for Dad in the detached garage, with a bath and kitchenette.
contractor_reply: My [amount withheld] is for measured existing-condition drawings only, no design approval, permits or construction. Designer/owner to assess feasibility.

request: Can we put a floor up there for Christmas boxes? Maybe a guest room later.
contractor_reply: Owner's engineer approved 80 sq ft storage platform only in marked zone. [amount withheld] includes platform and access hatch trim. No bedroom or HVAC.

request: Can you add a bedroom with a closet off the back of our house?
contractor_reply: GC owns shell and trades. [amount withheld] for interior trim and closet shelving in one room after drywall/paint; owner supplies materials, no bathroom.

request: We want the house freshened up before listing. No gut remodel.
contractor_reply: Six rooms, walls only [amount withheld] fixed including paint. Owner handles furniture, ceilings and trim remain. One visit to sample wall before paint included.

request: Can we swap these deck boards and keep everything underneath?
contractor_reply: Only visible framing checked; hidden rot may show after lifting. [amount withheld] for boards, fasteners and disposal. Show any exposed rot and quote repair for written approval first.

request: Our porch steps bounce and the railing wiggles. Can you rebuild them?
contractor_reply: GC confirmed approved drawing and footings by others. [amount withheld] rebuild four steps and both rails to drawing after footing handoff. Leave porch deck.

request: Please take out our old fence and gate and replace the whole side.
contractor_reply: Measured 64 ft including 4-ft gate. [amount withheld] per installed fence ft outside opening, [amount withheld] gate installed, [amount withheld] demolition and disposal. Posts included. Same approved line.

request: The gate drags after rain. Can you shave the bottom?
contractor_reply: Hinge post moves. Shaving won't address it. [amount withheld] reset that post and rehang existing leaf, then test swing and latch. No grading.

request: We bought a pergola kit. Can you build it this Saturday?
contractor_reply: Assembly only after owner’s contractor installs approved anchors; dates not confirmed. [amount withheld] labor, kit owner supplied.

request: Several pavers wobble by the step. Can you fix just those?
contractor_reply: Base inspected and firm. Lift and reuse pavers over 16 sq ft, correct bedding and restore joints. [amount withheld] fixed, no whole patio work.

request: Can you extend our patio out to the raised beds?
contractor_reply: New 4 × 18 ft path starts beyond patio. [amount withheld] per installed sq ft includes strip turf, compacted base, pavers/edges and spoil disposal. Existing patio untouched.

request: We're looking for someone who can mow the lawn every ten days.
contractor_reply: [amount withheld] per completed visit, mow front and back, trim fence line and blow driveway. No season length. First visit is normal growth.

request: Two beds need mulch. Can you deliver and spread it?
contractor_reply: Each bed measures 8 × 12 ft; apply 3 in. [amount withheld] fixed incl mulch, delivery and spreading. No bed cutting or plants.

request: Can you cut our tall hedge and take the branches away?
contractor_reply: Only 30 linear ft of ground-accessible hedge, [amount withheld] trim and chip on site. Owner now wants chips left by shed. No hauling.

request: Can you sod the bare strip the plumbers dug up?
contractor_reply: Measured 90 sq ft; [amount withheld] prep and sod, first watering included. Owner waters after that. Repair limited to marked trench.

request: One sprinkler zone won't turn on. Can you replace the bad valve?
contractor_reply: Fault not established. [amount withheld] diagnosis of that zone only. If repair identified show findings and quote for approval first.

request: Water pools next to the house. Can you bury the downspout?
contractor_reply: Outlet not verified. Owner chose a temporary aboveground extension, [amount withheld] supply and attach. No buried run or promise to solve all ponding.

request: I'd like the gutters cleaned before winter, including the detached garage.
contractor_reply: Access confirmed on house only. [amount withheld] house gutter clean and check downspout flow. Garage roof scheduled for replacement, skip it. Debris bagged in owner's bin.

request: Wind-driven rain gets past a window. Can you seal the outside?
contractor_reply: No confirmed leak source. [amount withheld] inspect exposed joints and report only, no caulking promised until agreed.

request: Two strips of vinyl siding blew off. Can you make it look the same?
contractor_reply: Owner has two compatible spares, weathered color difference accepted. [amount withheld] refit/replace two strips, check exposed attachment, no whole-wall recolor.

request: The block wall behind my patio leans. Can you just straighten it?
contractor_reply: I am not rebuilding the wall. Owner will get a qualified assessment first; no scope or price beyond that handoff.
